facts.fact_text: On 26 October 2008 a demonstration was held in Gaziantep to protest about the conditions of detention and alleged ill-treatment of Abdullah Öcalan, the leader of the PKK (an illegal armed organisation).
The Adana Assize Court found it established that the applicant had participated in the demonstration of 26 October 2008.
The Adana Assize Court found it established that the applicant had covered his face during the illegal demonstration of 26 October 2008.
According to a police report dated 31 December 2008, on 26 October 2008 clashes occurred between demonstrators and the police in three neighbourhoods in Gaziantep.
On 12 March 2009 the applicant was arrested in relation to the charges brought against him in the bill of indictment of 18 February 2009.
Following his arrest on 12 March 2009, the applicant was subsequently detained on remand in relation to the charges brought against him in the bill of indictment of 18 February 2009.

On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK, under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Article 220 § 6 and Article 314 § 3 of the same Code.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court sentenced the applicant to six years and three months' imprisonment for membership of an illegal organisation, the PKK.
On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court convicted the applicant of disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).

On 9 June 2009 the Adana Assize Court sentenced the applicant to ten months' imprisonment for disseminating propaganda in support of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with membership of an illegal organisation under Article 314 of the Turkish Criminal Code.
The applicant was charged with disseminating propaganda in favour of the PKK under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713).

On 5 July 2012 Law no. 6352, amending various laws with a view to suspending proceedings and sentences given in cases concerning crimes committed through the press and media and similar expressions of opinions, entered into force.
On 11 April 2013 Law no. 6459 amending Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code entered into force.

On 20 June 2013, in the light of the amendment made to Article 220 § 6 of the Turkish Criminal Code by Law no. 6459, the Adana Assize Court decided to suspend the execution of the prison sentence given to the applicant under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Article 220 § 6 and Article 314 § 3 of the same Code.

On 5 November 2013 the Adana Assize Court quashed the applicant's criminal conviction under Article 314 § 2 of the Turkish Criminal Code, on the basis of Article 220 § 6 and Article 314 § 3 of the same Code.

On 5 November 2013 the Adana Assize Court rejected the applicant's application for the conviction under section 7(2) of the Prevention of Terrorism Act (Law no. 3713) to be quashed, in the light of its considerations in its judgment of 9 June 2009 and, in particular, in the light of the fact that the applicant had participated in the demonstration of 26 October 2008 while he had his face partially covered.

As a result of the clashes on 26 October 2008 in Gaziantep, public buildings were damaged by some demonstrators who threw stones.
